title: Trophée des champions: Paris Saint-Germain Edge Marseille in nail-biting Classic
summary: After a wild night of drama, Paris Saint-Germain claimed their first trophy of the year at Marseille’s expense, prevailing 2-2 before winning 4-1 on penalties. The Parisians kick off 2026 in style, lifting a record-extending 14th Trophée des champions, their 12th in the last 13 editions.
